landing_context.context_cutoff_note: Evening of Day 2 (2023-04-28). Picks 1-100 of the 2023 draft are observable, including the Colts taking Anthony Richardson at pick 4. Nothing later is admitted.

returning_receiver_depth_chart.status_at_cutoff: Returning; established possession X/flanker and target leader.
Returning 2022 R2 pick; vertical outside profile, minimal slot overlap.
Veteran slot signed in offseason 2023; modest one-year commitment.

vacated_targets.season_basis: 2022 REG targets of Parris Campbell (91), who signed with the NY Giants 2023-03-16. Campbell played 87%+ of his snaps from the slot in 2022 (qualitative), so the vacancy maps directly onto Downs' archetype.
vacated_targets.slot_share_note: Campbell slot-share percentage is qualitative recall, needs_verification; his 91 targets and slot-primary role are directionally solid.

vacated_routes_or_snaps.note: Route/snap data unavailable for 2022 (no governed source; upstream nulls by design).

quarterback_state.starter: Unsettled: Anthony Richardson (drafted pick 4 overall on 2023-04-27, one day before Downs) and veteran bridge Gardner Minshew (signed 2023-03-16, 1yr/$3.5M).
quarterback_state.status_at_cutoff: Fourth different Week-1 QB in four years was guaranteed. Richardson entered as a high-ceiling, low-college-volume passer (single full college starting season); near-term passing quality and volume highly uncertain.

coaching_and_scheme_state.head_coach: Shane Steichen, hired February 2023 from Eagles OC role

expected_change_inference.read: Steichen's Eagles/Chargers background implied a spread-friendly, 11-personnel, RPO-and-quick-game offense that historically feeds slot receivers and layups underneath — a strong stylistic match for Downs, and structurally friendly to a rookie QB.

prior_season_offense_quality.qualitative: Dysfunctional 2022 offense (revolving QBs: Ryan, Ehlinger, Foles; midseason coaching change) with bottom-tier scoring despite decent raw target volume. Floor was low; direction under a new staff unknowable.

projected_role_openings.role: Starting slot from Day 1: Campbell's 91 slot targets vacated, McKenzie the only veteran competition, and no other slot archetype on roster
Rookie-QB checkdown/hot-route beneficiary in a Steichen quick-game structure

role_competition.basis: veteran slot on a cheap one-year deal — capital says Downs wins
target-share ceiling: Pittman commands the first read

opportunity_interpretation.read: Role-favorable, environment-risky. The cleanest slot vacancy of the 2023 draft mapped exactly onto Downs' archetype, with only nominal veteran competition — a high-probability path to immediate snaps and 70+ targets. The cap was the quarterback: a bridge veteran and the rawest first-round QB of the class meant target quality and scoring environment carried unusually wide error bars.
contingencies: Richardson's readiness/accuracy as a rookie passer
Steichen actually installing an 11-personnel slot-heavy structure
Offense functional enough to sustain 550+ team targets

limitations: No governed April 2023 depth-chart snapshot; ordering derived from 2022 usage plus verified transactions.
McKenzie signing date/terms recalled from public record, needs verification.
Campbell slot-share figure is qualitative recall.
Governed 2022 team-environment data (pace, PROE, EPA) does not exist in any TIBER repo.
